import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Income Distribution by Education Level
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
education_order = ['PhD', 'Graduation', 'Master', '2n Cycle', 'Basic']
education_present = [ed for ed in education_order if ed in df['Education'].unique()]
sns.boxplot(data=df, y='Education', x='Income', order=education_present, ax=ax1, palette='Set2')
ax1.set_title('Income Distribution by Education', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Income ($)')
ax1.set_ylabel('Education Level')

# 2. Total Spending by Category
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
spending_cols = ['MntWines', 'MntFruits', 'MntMeatProducts', 'MntFishProducts', 'MntSweetProducts', 'MntGoldProds']
spending_totals = df[spending_cols].sum()
spending_labels = ['Wines', 'Fruits', 'Meat', 'Fish', 'Sweets', 'Gold']
colors = plt.cm.Set3(np.linspace(0, 1, len(spending_labels)))
ax2.pie(spending_totals, labels=spending_labels, autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors, startangle=90)
ax2.set_title('Total Spending by Product Category', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 3. Age Distribution
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
current_year = 2014  # Based on the dates in the data
df['Age'] = current_year - df['Year_Birth']
ax3.hist(df['Age'], bins=20, color='steelblue', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax3.set_title('Customer Age Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Age (years)')
ax3.set_ylabel('Frequency')
ax3.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 4. Purchase Channels Comparison
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
channel_cols = ['NumWebPurchases', 'NumCatalogPurchases', 'NumStorePurchases']
channel_totals = df[channel_cols].sum()
channel_labels = ['Web', 'Catalog', 'Store']
bars = ax4.bar(channel_labels, channel_totals, color=['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4', '#45B7D1'], edgecolor='black')
ax4.set_title('Total Purchases by Channel', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Number of Purchases')
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)
for bar in bars:
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax4.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height,
             f'{int(height)}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontweight='bold')

# 5. Marital Status Distribution
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
marital_counts = df['Marital_Status'].value_counts()
colors_marital = plt.cm.Pastel1(np.linspace(0, 1, len(marital_counts)))
ax5.bar(marital_counts.index, marital_counts.values, color=colors_marital, edgecolor='black')
ax5.set_title('Customer Marital Status', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_ylabel('Count')
ax5.set_xlabel('Marital Status')
plt.setp(ax5.xaxis.get_majorticklabels(), rotation=45, ha='right')
ax5.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 6. Income vs Total Spending
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
df['TotalSpending'] = df[spending_cols].sum(axis=1)
scatter = ax6.scatter(df['Income'], df['TotalSpending'], 
                     c=df['Age'], cmap='viridis', alpha=0.6, s=50, edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax6.set_title('Income vs Total Spending', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_xlabel('Income ($)')
ax6.set_ylabel('Total Spending ($)')
ax6.grid(alpha=0.3)
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax6)
cbar.set_label('Age', rotation=270, labelpad=15)

# 7. Kids at Home Distribution
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
df['TotalKids'] = df['Kidhome'] + df['Teenhome']
kids_counts = df['TotalKids'].value_counts().sort_index()
ax7.bar(kids_counts.index, kids_counts.values, color='lightcoral', edgecolor='black')
ax7.set_title('Number of Children at Home', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_xlabel('Number of Kids')
ax7.set_ylabel('Number of Customers')
ax7.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 8. Campaign Response Rate
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
campaign_cols = ['AcceptedCmp1', 'AcceptedCmp2', 'AcceptedCmp3', 'AcceptedCmp4', 'AcceptedCmp5', 'Response']
campaign_response = df[campaign_cols].sum()
campaign_labels = ['Cmp1', 'Cmp2', 'Cmp3', 'Cmp4', 'Cmp5', 'Last Cmp']
colors_cmp = plt.cm.Set2(np.linspace(0, 1, len(campaign_labels)))
ax8.bar(campaign_labels, campaign_response, color=colors_cmp, edgecolor='black')
ax8.set_title('Campaign Acceptance Rates', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax8.set_ylabel('Number of Acceptances')
ax8.set_xlabel('Campaign')
ax8.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 9. Recency Distribution
ax9 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
ax9.hist(df['Recency'], bins=20, color='mediumseagreen', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax9.set_title('Days Since Last Purchase (Recency)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax9.set_xlabel('Days')
ax9.set_ylabel('Frequency')
ax9.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

plt.suptitle('Customer Marketing Campaign Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
